system.name: Carrier
system.summary: External carrier that delivers shipments to customers. It accepts shipment requests and reports delivery progress back.

system.name: Shipping System
system.summary: Internal system that hands packed orders to carriers. It reacts to ready-for-shipping orders and creates shipments with an external carrier.

system.name: Cart System
system.summary: Internal system that owns the customer's shopping cart and the checkout flow. It is the source of truth for cart contents and publishes an event when a cart is checked out.

system.name: Promotion System
system.summary: Internal system that calculates the discounts and promotions that apply to a cart. It owns promotion rules and returns calculated discounts to the Cart System.

system.name: Checkout System
system.summary: Internal system that orchestrates checkout. When a cart is checked out it reserves inventory, authorizes payment, and asks the Order Management System to create the order.

system.name: Order Management System
system.summary: Internal system that is the source of truth for orders. It creates orders, tracks their lifecycle, and publishes events as orders are created, completed and cancelled.

system.name: Customer Management System
system.summary: Internal system that is the source of truth for customer profile data. Owns the customer database and publishes customer change events for the rest of the business to consume.

system.name: Identity Provider
system.summary: The identity system that authenticates customers. It is the source of truth for credentials and login, verifies sign-in attempts, and emits an event when a customer successfully authenticates.

system.name: Finance Reporting System
system.summary: Internal system that produces month-end finance reports. It works on its own, with no connections to other systems.

system.name: Fraud Detection
system.summary: External provider that screens payments for fraud. It consumes payment requests and returns a pass or fail verdict.

system.name: Payment Processing System
system.summary: Internal system that orchestrates payment for orders. It authorizes payments, requests charges from the external payment processor, handles the outcome, and issues refunds.

system.name: Inventory System
system.summary: Internal system that tracks stock and reserves it for orders. It is the source of truth for available inventory and confirms whether stock can be reserved.

system.name: Warehouse System
system.summary: Internal system that picks and packs orders in the warehouse. It reacts to completed orders, organises picking, and signals when an order is packed and ready to ship.

system.name: Loyalty System
system.summary: Internal system that calculates, stores and reverses customer loyalty points in response to order events.

system.name: Stripe
system.summary: External payment processor used by Acme Inc to charge cards and issue refunds. It receives payment and refund requests and reports outcomes back via webhook events.

system.name: Product Catalog System
system.summary: Internal system that is the source of truth for product data. Owns the product database and publishes product change events for the rest of the business to consume.

system.name: Search System
system.summary: Internal system that keeps product data searchable. Consumes product change events from the Product Catalog System, maintains a search index, and serves fast product search to the rest of the business.

system.name: Returns System
system.summary: Internal system that accepts, approves and tracks customer returns through to their arrival back at the warehouse.
